title: 2278. Percentage of Letter in String

examples.explanation: The percentage of characters in s that equal the letter 'o' is 2 / 6 * 100% = 33% when rounded down, so we return 33.
The percentage of characters in s that equal the letter 'k' is 0%, so we return 0.
